cards.ko: 준비 다 됐어요, 다 됐어요 (더 필요 없어요)
cards.ex: Do you need anything else? — No, I'm all set. Thanks!

cards.ko: 우적우적 먹다 / 후루룩 소리 내며 먹다
cards.ex: He's munching on chips. → Don't slurp your soup! (munch on N, slurp noodles)
Hey, Jake! Long time no see. How have you been?
I skimmed the email. → She doodles during meetings. (skim through N, doodle on paper)
You know my cousin? What a small world!

quiz.q: Can I get you anything else? — No thanks, I'm all ___ .
quiz.note: I'm all set = 다 됐어요. 식당·가게에서 '더 필요 없어요'라고 할 때 딱.
Long time no see = 오랜만이야. 문법은 이상해도 원어민이 그대로 써요.

quiz.q: I didn't read the whole report. I just ___ it.
quiz.note: skim = 대충 훑어 읽다. skim through N도 같은 뜻.

quiz.q: Your boss went to my high school? ___ !
quiz.note: What a small world! = 세상 좁다! It's a small world라고도 해요.

cards.ex: The parking lot fills up early. — Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
Go mingle with the guests! → Pamper yourself this weekend. (mingle with N, pamper yourself)
You cook, I'll do the dishes. — It's a deal!

cards.ko: 바쁘게 뛰어다니다, 열심히 일하다 / 몰아서 하다
cards.ex: She hustles to pay the rent. → I binged the whole series. (side hustle = 부업, binge-watch = 정주행)
I failed, but I'll try again next week. — That's the spirit!

quiz.q: The museum is closed on Mondays. — Oh, thanks. I'll ___ that in mind.
quiz.note: keep N in mind = 기억해 두다. 조언 들었을 때 자연스러운 대답.

quiz.q: At the party, I didn't know anyone, so I tried to ___ .
If you drive, I'll pay for gas. — ___ !
quiz.note: It's a deal = 콜, 그렇게 하자. Deal! 한 단어로도 써요.

quiz.q: I ___ all eight episodes in one night.
quiz.note: binge (on) N = 몰아서 하다. binge-watch = 정주행.

quiz.q: I'm nervous, but I'm going to give it my best. — ___ !
quiz.note: That's the spirit! = 그런 자세 좋아! 긍정적인 태도를 칭찬할 때.

cards.ex: I'm exhausted. I'm going to hit the sack.
A meager salary → a quaint little town (meager = 양이 적은, quaint = 옛 정취가 있는)
This dinner won't break the bank. It's really cheap.
A rowdy crowd → a hushed voice (rowdy fans, in hushed tones = 소곤소곤)
Relax, I'm just pulling your leg. I didn't really quit.

quiz.note: hit the sack = 잠자리에 들다. hit the hay도 같은 뜻.

quiz.q: The pay was ___ , so he looked for another job.
quiz.note: meager = 양·액수가 너무 적은. 영국 철자 meagre.

quiz.q: A good haircut doesn't have to ___ .
quiz.note: break the bank = 큰돈이 들다. 주로 won't/doesn't와 함께.

quiz.q: The fans got ___ after the team won.
quiz.note: rowdy = 시끄럽고 거친. a rowdy crowd/party.

quiz.q: You won the lottery? Are you ___ ?
quiz.note: pull someone's leg = 농담으로 속이다. Are you pulling my leg? = 장난이지?
